profiles.name: Generic
profiles.description: A mid-size bass shaker of no particular make: a typical 4 to 8 ohm, 50 watt unit such as an AuraSound AST-2B-4 or Reckhorn BS-200. A starting point; pick a named profile where one fits.
profiles.notes: Class defaults, not measured on any one unit.

profiles.name: Dayton TT25 Puck
profiles.description: Dayton Audio TT25-8 / TT25-16 tactile transducer (the Puck). Spec sheet: Fs 40 Hz, usable response 20 to 80 Hz, 15 watts RMS. Light moving mass.
profiles.notes: Resonance and band from the spec sheet; pulse shape and brake are the light-mass defaults.

profiles.name: Dayton BST-1
profiles.description: Dayton Audio BST-1 bass shaker. Spec sheet: Fs 30 Hz unmounted, response 10 to 80 Hz, 50 watts RMS, 4 ohms. Mid moving mass.
profiles.notes: Resonance and band from the spec sheet; pulse shape and brake are the mid-mass defaults.

profiles.name: Dayton BST-2
profiles.description: Dayton Audio BST-2 bass shaker, aluminum housing. Spec sheet: Fs 30 Hz unmounted, response 10 to 80 Hz, 35 watts RMS, 4 ohms. Mid moving mass.
profiles.notes: Resonance and band from the spec sheet; pulse shape and brake are the mid-mass defaults.

profiles.name: ButtKicker Gamer2
profiles.description: ButtKicker Gamer2, the clamp-on unit with its own 100 watt amplifier. Published: response 10 to 250 Hz, 2 ohms. No resonance or piston weight is published; the unit is light, close to the Gamer Pro's class, and 30 Hz is an estimate.
profiles.notes: Light piston: single half-wave with a mild brake. Band floor kept at 15 Hz so slow effects render as pulses; the top is held at 200 Hz, where the other pistons stop, since nothing a seat needs is higher. Resonance estimated, not measured.

profiles.name: ButtKicker Gamer Pro
profiles.description: ButtKicker Gamer Pro (the PRO haptic transducer). Spec sheet: response 5 to 200 Hz, 75 to 250 watts, 2 ohms, 1 lb piston, 4.9 lb unit. No resonance figure is published; 30 Hz is an estimate.
profiles.notes: A piston a quarter the weight of the LFE's: single half-wave with a moderate brake. Band top from the spec sheet, floor kept at 15 Hz so slow effects render as pulses. Resonance estimated, not measured.

profiles.name: ButtKicker LFE
profiles.description: ButtKicker LFE, a heavy piston shaker. Spec sheet: response 5 to 200 Hz, 400 to 1500 watts, 4 ohms, 3.75 lb piston, 11 lb unit. No resonance figure is published; 25 Hz is an estimate.
profiles.notes: Heavy piston: single half-wave plus a strong brake to stop it ringing. Band top from the spec sheet; the floor is kept at 15 Hz so slow effects render as pulses rather than sub-audio tones. Resonance estimated, not measured.
